findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Employees were observed donning gloves without handwashing. Education was carried out. The behavior was abolished. Ensure that adequate handwashing procedures are followed before donning gloves in between tasks.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: (A) After touching bare human body parts other than clean hands and clean, exposed portions of arms; (B) After using the toilet room; (C) After caring for or handling SERVICE ANIMALS or aquatic animals as specified in 2-403.11(B); (D) Except as specified in 2-401.11(B), after coughing, sneezing, using a handkerchief or disposable tissue, using TOBACCO PRODUCTS, eating, or drinking; (E) After handling soiled EQUIPMENT or UTENSILS; (F) During FOOD preparation, as often as necessary to remove soil and contamination and to prevent cross contamination when changing tasks; (G) When switching between working with raw FOOD and working with READY-TO-EAT FOOD; (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD; and (I) After engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: The hand sink in the meat cutting room was observed cluttered with brushes and scrubs. Education was provided. An employee removed the items from the hand sink to render it accessible. Ensure that all hand sinks within the facility are available and accessible at all times.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: REPEAT The quaternary ammonia sanitizer in the bucket by the counter of the meat department was observed reading between 100-0 ppm. Discussed with the PIC and a sani bucket was remade. Ensure that the concentration of the sanitizer is monitored and tested at a regular frequency.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(E) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (E) If a chemical SANITIZER other than chlorine, iodine, or a quaternary ammonium compound is used, it shall be applied in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: There were an assortment of cardboard boxes of food items stored directly on the floor in the back for dry storage. Discussed with the PIC. The PIC assured inspector that the boxes will be removed from the floor. Ensure that food items are stored at least 6-inches above the floor to protect them from splash, dust, and other contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed dirty mop water sitting in the bucket in the janitorial cage area in the back. Discussed with the PIC. The waster was discarded. Ensure that employees are aware to always discard the mop water after use.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.15 Cleaning Maintenance Tools, Preventing Contamination. FOOD preparation sinks, HANDWASHING SINKS, and WAREWASHING EQUIPMENT may not be used for the cleaning of maintenance tools, the preparation or holding of maintenance materials, or the disposal of mop water and similar liquid wastes.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed no sani bucket in the produce prep room during food prep. Discussed with PIC and a sani bucket was made to have this violation corrected. Ensure that a sani bucket is available during food prep at all times.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: There was no sanitizer available during the cut-fruit prep in the produce prep room. PIC was made aware that a sanitizer bucket needs to be available during food prep at all times. A sanitizer bucket was made to correct this violation. Ensure that a sanitizer is prepared during food prep at all times. A follow-up is set for 04/25/2025.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The accumulation of Ice behind the fan and on the floor in the walk in freezers in the back storage area. Discussed with PIC and PIC ensured inspectors that the ice will be cleaned up. Ensure that the the ice is removed to provide a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
findings.citation_text: 6-201.16(B) Wall and Ceiling Coverings and Coatings. (B) Except in areas used only for dry storage, concrete, porous blocks, or bricks used for indoor wall construction shall be finished and SEALED to provide a SMOOTH, nonabsorbent, EASILY CLEANABLE surface.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The accumulation of soils and food items were observed under shelves. Discussed with PIC and PIC ensured that the accumulation of soils and food items will be cleaned during their inventory inspection. Ensure that shelves in the facility is monitored and cleaned at a regular frequency to prevent the accumulation of soil and food items under shelves for a prolonged period of time .
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
